title: Chapter 496 - 496 Request; Award!
content:
Chapter 496 - 496 Request; Award!

Chapter 496 - 496 Request; Award!

496 Request; Award!

It had to be said that Feng Zhixiang was very efficient.

The next day, Lin Fan received a call from Feng Zhixiang. He said that he had helped him register his company.

In addition, he had also helped him find a few plots of land that met his requirements and wanted him to go over and take a look.

Lin Fan asked Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, and the others to continue studying in the office. If they encountered questions that they could not answer, they could wait for him to come back.

Then, he drove the Cullinan straight to the place Feng Zhixiang had mentioned.

About 20 minutes later, Lin Fan arrived at his destination.

There were a few dilapidated old factories, a few low hills, and a few small lakes… The place looked rather desolate.

However, he was looking to build a controllable nuclear fusion plant, not a financial center.

It was not a big deal for the place to be a little desolate.

At this moment, a gentle breeze blew over from afar, making people feel refreshed.

“This is the closest place to Jiangbei University,” Feng Zhixiang said. “The other place is…”

However, before he could finish, Lin Fan said, “This is it.”

Firstly, this place had mountains, water, and pleasant air.

Secondly, it was the closest to Jiangbei University.

If he did not choose this place, where should he pick?

Feng Zhixiang did not expect Lin Fan to make such a choice.

One had to know…

He was going to spend tens of billions to build a controllable nuclear fusion plant!

Did it take just one minute for Lin Fan to arrive here and make a decision?

After a while, Feng Zhixiang stuttered, “Okay… Alright.”

At this moment, one, two, three…

Many SUVs drove over from afar, and men and women wearing white helmets, red helmets, or white shirts stepped out of them.

Feng Zhixiang pointed at a middle-aged man who was about 50 years old and said, “Professor Lin, this is Chief Engineer Dai Lide from Hua Construction. You can tell him about the design and requirements of the Ordinary Technology factory.”

“Hello, Chief Dai,” said Lin Fan.

Dai Lide did not dare to look down on Lin Fan just because he was a young man.

On the contrary, he seemed very excited and respectful.

One had to know…

Lin Fan was a super genius in the scientific research world.

In fact, Dai Lide had always regarded Lin Fan as his role model and idol!

He quickly stretched out his hands and held Lin Fan’s right hand tightly. “Hello, Professor Lin!

“Professor Lin, if you have any requirements for the factory, you can tell me.”

Lin Fan nodded. “First, it has to be big! The area had to be more than 10,000 acres!”

After all, the reason he was building the controllable nuclear fusion plant was to complete the mission.

“Second, you need to be fast! You can hire more workers and use more equipment like construction vehicles! You don’t have to worry about money. I’ll give you 20 billion in the early stages! I want to see speed!”

If a mission had to take three to five years, it would be meaningless.

“Third, you must ensure quality, especially safety!”

He did not want any risks.

If he completed the mission, Lin Fan would have the controllable nuclear fusion technology.

If the quality was worrying, it would cause a terrible disaster.

Dai Lide was like a soldier, standing straight and saying, “Professor Lin, please rest assured!”

At this point, the factory of Ordinary Technology officially started being built!

…

Lin Fan and Dai Lide discussed the details.

Then, Lin Fan returned to Jiangbei University.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded from outside the corridor.

The dean of the mathematics department, Hu Chuan, walked in quickly.

There were beads of sweat on his forehead, and he was panting heavily.

Obviously, he ran over.

Lin Fan said, “Director Hu, don’t be so anxious. Sit down and rest first.”

After all, Hu Chuan was already old.

If he was not careful and could not catch his breath, it would be troublesome.

Hu Chuan did not pay much attention to it. He said excitedly, “Professor Lin, the International Mathematics Center just called. They’ll be presenting you with the Fields Medal!”

As soon as he said that, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun all raised their heads and focused their gazes on Lin Fan.

Lin Fan solved Zhou’s Conjecture, the Twin Prime Number Conjecture, Hodge’s Conjecture, Hail’s Conjecture, and Riemann’s Hypothesis.

They knew that Lin Fan would definitely win the Fields Medal.

However, after receiving the news, they could not help but reveal an unconcealable excitement.

One had to know…

This was the Fields Medal that was known as the Nobel Prize in mathematics!

It was the highest award in the field of mathematics!

Compared to their excitement, Lin Fan was much calmer.

He drank a mouthful of Spirit Tea and said unhurriedly, “Alright, then I’ll go to Barney to accept the Fields Medal.”

It was not because Lin Fan was passionate about this award.

Firstly, Lin Fan still had to complete his mission of winning an international award.

The Fields Medal was obviously an international award.

Secondly, Lin Fan knew that Barney had the Totamac device, which was a necessary device for the controllable nuclear fusion mission.

A trip to Barney would allow him to complete two missions, so it was naturally worth it.

Hu Chuan quickly said, “I’ll go through the relevant procedures and prepare the plane tickets for you now.”

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “There’s no need to prepare plane tickets for me. I can go there myself.”

“Alright,” Hu Chuan said.

Then, he ran out in a hurry.

Jiangbei University was finally going to have a Fields Medal winner, and this was a rare opportunity to spread the word.

One had to know… In all of Hua Nation, even the Capital University and Huaqing University did not have a Fields Medal winner!

After Hu Chuan left, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun all shouted excitedly, “Professor Lin, congratulations!”

Lin Fan said, “It’s just an award. If you work hard, you can get it in the future.”

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others lowered their heads.

They could get it in the future?

Although they never thought that they were worse than anyone else, they never thought that they would one day win the Fields Medal.

“Professor Lin, can you take us to the Fields Medal ceremony?” Hao Zhiwu asked with a smile. “We can also gain some knowledge so that we’ll have more motivation to win the Fields Medal.”

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others rolled their eyes.

More motivated to win the Fields Medal?

Was this something that could be obtained with just motivation?

However, a look of anticipation appeared on their faces.

Obviously, they were very interested in attending the ceremony.
